summary: TEDx conference talks delivered in Brazilian Portuguese, segmented into utterances with their transcripts. One row is one such segment. The speech is prepared but delivered live, so it mixes fluent presentation with genuine spontaneity, applause and audience noise. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
notes: mTEDx Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) test split, 340 rows — TEDx-talk read/spontaneous speech with transcripts. Closes the salvage audit's pt-BR gap; facebook/multilingual_librispeech's pt subset was considered but its refs/convert/parquet layout is per-language/split/shard (portuguese/test/0000.parquet) rather than the {subset}/{split}-NNNNN-of-MMMMM.parquet convention runner/audio_io.py's _parquet_files() prefix-matches, so it falls through to grabbing every language/split shard in the repo instead of isolating Portuguese — not registered, see PR notes.
